summary: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 announcing that its board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.4843750 per share on its 7.75% Series A Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, with a record date of September 18, 2026 and payment date of September 30, 2026. The preferred stock trades on the NYSE under BW PRA. No advisor, premium, stake, or strategic transaction is involved; this is an ordinary dividend declaration with no special-situations mechanics, overhang, or regulatory clock, and no risk-arb angle applies.
